prose: Split from b15da5656579 under RULE 1 (orchestrator 2026-11-16, relaying Akien: "the latest entry remains in cairn commons, and everything else broken into... per day? per week? inside of our .cairn/logs folder"). After b15d the commons journal holds only the newest entry per path, so cairn/tools/base/cast.py sweep_casts, which classifies a ticket by the FIRST journal entry naming it, and probes/the_casting_door_has_callers.py, which counts what arrives beside the door, read one entry per ticket. They must read artifact.read_trail(root), which holds every entry this box's doors wrote for 30 days. A census read from the trail sees only 30 days, and the ticket says so: a ticket first written before that horizon has no first entry in the trail.
